description.text: The twelfth and last main Sword & Shield set, released on 11 November 2022 with 215 cards, 195 and 20 secret rares, and a 30-card Trainer Gallery. Lugia VSTAR leads it, with Alolan Vulpix VSTAR, Serperior VSTAR, Unown VSTAR and Mawile VSTAR, and Regieleki VMAX and Regidrago VSTAR.
